summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on running large data processing jobs for analytics. One participant noted that the Brazil traffic data for half a year was successfully processed, and they are now proceeding with impression data processing. They plan to process impressions by day to manage memory usage, unlike the previous full-period approach.

It was discussed that scripts often consume excessive resources (CPU/memory) when loading large datasets from the database at once. One participant suggested rewriting the script to process data in smaller chunks (e.g., monthly instead of half a year).

Another technical discussion point involved server resource management, specifically suggesting the implementation of zram for compressed swap space.
decisions: The Brazil traffic data for six months was successfully processed.
Impression data processing will be done by day to manage memory usage.
action_items: One participant plans to rewrite the script to process data in smaller time increments (e.g., monthly) to prevent excessive resource consumption.
